statements.__comment__: Drop legacy AWSAccount->RESOURCE edges to pre-migration shared IpRange nodes.
statements.query: MATCH (:AWSAccount {guard0_org_id: $GUARD0_ORG_ID})-[r:RESOURCE {guard0_org_id: $GUARD0_ORG_ID}]->(n:IpRange {guard0_org_id: $GUARD0_ORG_ID}) WHERE NOT n:AWSIpRange AND NOT n:Ontology AND n._module_name IN ['cartography:aws', 'cartography:gcp'] DELETE r

statements.__comment__: Drop legacy AWSAccount->RESOURCE edges to pre-migration shared IpRule nodes.
statements.query: MATCH (:AWSAccount {guard0_org_id: $GUARD0_ORG_ID})-[r:RESOURCE {guard0_org_id: $GUARD0_ORG_ID}]->(n:IpRule {guard0_org_id: $GUARD0_ORG_ID}) WHERE NOT n:AWSIpRule AND NOT n:Ontology AND n.ruleid IS NOT NULL AND n._module_name IN ['cartography:aws', 'cartography:gcp'] DELETE r

statements.__comment__: Drop legacy AWSAccount->RESOURCE edges to pre-migration shared SG-style inbound rule nodes only.
statements.query: MATCH (:AWSAccount {guard0_org_id: $GUARD0_ORG_ID})-[r:RESOURCE {guard0_org_id: $GUARD0_ORG_ID}]->(n:IpPermissionInbound {guard0_org_id: $GUARD0_ORG_ID}) WHERE NOT n:AWSIpPermissionInbound AND NOT n:Ontology AND n.ruleid IS NOT NULL AND n._module_name IN ['cartography:aws', 'cartography:gcp'] DELETE r

statements.__comment__: Delete legacy IpRange nodes that were never re-created with provider-scoped labels.
statements.query: MATCH (n:IpRange {guard0_org_id: $GUARD0_ORG_ID}) WHERE NOT (n:AWSIpRange OR n:GCPIpRange) AND NOT n:Ontology AND n._module_name IN ['cartography:aws', 'cartography:gcp'] DETACH DELETE n

statements.__comment__: Delete legacy IpRule nodes that were never re-created with provider-scoped labels.
statements.query: MATCH (n:IpRule {guard0_org_id: $GUARD0_ORG_ID}) WHERE NOT (n:AWSIpRule OR n:GCPIpRule) AND NOT n:Ontology AND n.ruleid IS NOT NULL AND n._module_name IN ['cartography:aws', 'cartography:gcp'] DETACH DELETE n

statements.__comment__: Delete legacy SG-style IpPermissionInbound nodes that were never re-created with provider-scoped labels.
statements.query: MATCH (n:IpPermissionInbound {guard0_org_id: $GUARD0_ORG_ID}) WHERE NOT (n:AWSIpPermissionInbound OR n:GCPIpRule) AND NOT n:Ontology AND n.ruleid IS NOT NULL AND n._module_name IN ['cartography:aws', 'cartography:gcp'] DETACH DELETE n
